tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// chos mngon pa rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ a bhi dharma bi bharya kā ri kā/ bod skad du/ chos mngon pa rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa| 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub byed goms las mi gnas myang 'das dbyings// nyid zhugs lam gsum de la phyag byas nas// kun las btus pa 'dir chud 'dis de ni// rnam par 'byed pas man ngag nyid du bshad// mngon du'i phyir dang yang yang phyir| /zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos// don dang brda yis rab phye ba// mtshan nyid rnam par nges pas bstan// du dang ci phyir nyer len dang*// mtshan nyid de yi rnam gzhag dang*// go rim don dang dpe dbye dang*// bsdus dang mtshungs ldan ldan pa dang*| /bden dang chos thob 'bel gtam mo// phung khams skye mched du zhe na// phung po lnga dang khams bco brgyad// skye mched bcu gnyis legs par gsungs// nye bar len pa'i phung khams skye// ldan pa'i chos kyis gdags par mdzad// nyer len 'dun dang 'dod chags te// ma 'ongs da lta'i phung po ni// mngon par 'grub dang yongs mi gtong*// bdag gi gzhi lnga brjod phyir dang*// lus dang yongs su gzung gnyis kyis| /'das dang da lta'i nyer spyod drug /'dzin phyir gnyis nyid ma 'ongs pa'i// rnam shes drug gi skye sgo'i phyir// phung po btags yod phyir ngo bo// brjod pas dmigs kyis dbye mi nus// 'on kyang de rten gyi brjod pas// de'i yang rtogs par 'gyur phyir ro// reg yul dpyad gzugs rung myong ba// 'dus te shes byed dmigs la sems// mngon par 'du byed don ngo tsam// dam par shes byed gzugs sogs mtshon// byung ba'i nyer spyod 'dzin pa khams// gnas dang yul dang rang mtshan sgos// dbang yul rnam shes khams thams cad| /ma byung rnam shes skye ba'i sgo// skye mched dbye rnams gnas dmigs pas// gzugs kyi rnam gzhag 'byung chen bzhi// de rgyur byas gzugs bcu gcig go

/rnam shes rten gzugs dang ba dbang*// dbang po'i spyod yul don zhes bya// gzugs 'dir kha dog nyer gcig bzhi// sgra ni bcu gcig dri drug ro// bcu gnyis reg bya'i phyogs gcig la// nyer gnyis chos skye'i gzugs lnga de'i// yang dag blangs pa rig byed min// rnam rig byed dang ting 'dzin byung*// btags yod bstan med thogs med pa// tshor ba gnas ngo rten bsdus dang*// tshul gnyis spang gnyen dbye bas drug /gsum gnyis gnyis dang yang gnyis so// gzugs na sna lce'i 'khor tshor dang*// yid sems zang zing med duḥkha// zhen rten gsum med gnyis nas sdug /gsum dga' bzhi na bde gong mar// dbang shes lnga dang lus tshor med// 'du shes ngo bo gnas dmigs pas// lnga drug drug go 'du byed la// dge nyon gnas skabs la sems pas// sems pa gtsor bzhag de drug dbye// nyer spyod tha snyad 'dogs dngos phyir// tshor 'du phung po logs su smos// gzhan rtsod rtsa bar gyur sogs 'dod// de min rnams dang ldan pa min// thams cad phal pa'i 'du byed do// rdzas yul dus dang bya byed kyi// chos gang sems dang mtshungs ldan pa// sems las 'thon pas sems byung ngo*// de gnyis dpyad dka' yid brtan pa'i// lung dang rigs pas tha dad grub// tshor 'du sems pa yid byed reg /kun 'gro 'dun mos dran ting shes| /yul nges dad dang ngo tsha shes// khrel yod ma chags zhe sdang med// gti mug med brtson sbyangs bag yod// btang snyoms rnam mi 'tshe rnams dge /'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal dang*// ma rig the tshom lta rtsa nyon// 'jig tshogs mthar 'dzin mchog 'dzin gnyis// log lta de las sgro skur dang*// sngon gyi lung ma bstan gyi lta// lnga gzigs mtha' bsal tha nyi shur// bdag dang bdag gir lta 'jigs lta// ma dpyad gzhi can dag tu bshad// khro dang 'khon 'dzin 'chab dang tshig /phrag dog ser sna sgyu g.yo rgyags// rnam 'tshe ngo tsha med khrel med// dmu rgod ma dad le lo dang*// bag med brjed ngas shes bzhin min// rnam g.yeng nye nyon gnyid 'gyod dang*// rtog dpyod gzhan 'gyur de dag rnams// mtshan nyid byed las gnyis gyis bshad// dang po bcu dang dge ba'i bdun// rtsa nyon lnga ni rdzas lhag ma// btags yod 'dod na med sbyangs pa// gzugs na drug gsum gcig gnyis med// khyad par can nas rtog pa dang*// gnyis nas spyod dang g.yo sgyu yang*// 'dod dge'i sems la rdzas bcu drug

/ma 'dres mi dger bcu gcig dang*// 'dres dang bsgribs la bcu gsum dang*| /ma bsgribs la bcu gtso cher yin// gzugs sems sems byung gnas skabs la// btags pa de nyid dang gzhan du// brjod med ldan pa min 'du byed// btags yod 'dir bzhed rdzas 'dod gzhan// thob dang 'du shes med snyoms 'jug /'gog snyoms 'du shes med pa dang*// srog dbang rigs mthun skye rga gnas// mi rtag ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs// so skye 'jug pa so sor nges// sbyor 'brel mgyogs pa go rim dus// yul grangs tshogs pa'o gnas dang ni// ngo bo gdags pa gsum gyis so| /rnam phung sems bde rnam shes so// kun gzhi rnam smin len rnam shes// de dag bag chags bsags phyir sems// rtag tu rloms sems bdag nyid can// der brten der dmigs nyon mongs bzhi// mtshungs ldan nyon mongs can gyur yid// lam mngon gyur dang 'gog zhugs dang*// mi slob sar min thams cad 'gro// rnam grangs drug po 'gags ma thag /ngo bo nyid dang gnas dang ni// dmigs pa dang ni grogs rnams dang*// las te sgo ni lnga po las// sems byung ba gang rnam shes drug /sems ni rang bzhin dang ba ste// rnyog par byed pa yid yin no// rnam par shes dang bcas pa'i yid// rtag tu bag chags 'debs par byed// gzugs kyi dbang don gzugs can khams// chos skye'i gzugs dang phung po gsum// chos khams tha mas rnam shes khams// 'dus ma byas pa don med phyir// phung por ma bzhag de brgyad de// de bzhin nyid gsum nam mkha' dang*// 'gog pa gnyis dang mi g.yo dang*// 'du shes tshor ba 'gog pa'o// gzugs lnga phung gsum 'dus ma byas// bcu drug chos kyi khams yin no// rnam shes skad cig der rgyu las// skye phyir dbang po'i ming can 'gyur// yul ni rgyun brtan de lta min// 'o na nyer gcig tu 'gyur ro// mtshan nyid 'dra bas rigs gcig dang*// bya ba gcig pas khams gcig nyid// dri ro rnam shes gnyis med pas// gzugs na bcu bzhi gzugs med gsum// gzugs can khams gang de'i skye mched// rnam shes yid skye chos khams chos// de phyir gzugs phung chos khams dang*| /yid skye yis ni thams cad bsdus// mig sogs khams drug la mu bzhi// 'og mig gong lus med des de'i// gzugs mthong ma yin bsgrubs nas lta// rang sa'i kun yin kun mtshungs pa// 'dod na mig sa lus gsum ka

/mi mtshungs pa yod gzugs yul yang*// 'dod gzugs rang sar spyod yid kyi// khams gsum zag med shes dang gong*// so skyes rang chos 'phags zag med// zag med yid kyis thams cad shes// gnas dang gnas pa rten brten pa// kun nyon rnam par byang nyid kyi| /phung po go rim bzhin du blugs// dbang po'i khams skye 'jig rten mthun// de rgyur byas yul gnas brten la// rten 'byung rnam shes dpung rgyas dang*// khur khyer phung don sa bon dang*// rang mtshan 'bras rgyu bsdus 'dzin khams// skye sgo gnyis sam lngas skye mched// gzugs ni dbu ba rdos sogs dpes// chos nyid bdag med mtshon pa yin// rab dbye rnam pa dang bsdus pa// rnam pa'i drug cu rtsa gcig rnams// ji ltar der 'jog tu zhig yod// ci phyir brtag pas dgos ched ston// dbang po'i spyod yul brjod de las// gzhan la ltos med rdzas grub bzlog /btags yod kun nyon rnam byang gi /dmigs dbyes kun rdzob don dam mo// bzhi lnga bcu gsum gyi shes bya// brgyad kyis rnam shes bya yul drug /mngon shes bya ba gzugs can du// nyi shus bzhag 'ga' 'brel dang 'bras// btags pa lngas dngos mig yul du// gtan yod rdugs pas thogs bcas te// yul dmigs sgrib thogs 'dir phyi ma// rgyu gsum rnam grangs gcig gis so// nyon mongs lhan 'byung zag bcas dang*// rtsod 'bru 'gyed pa 'thab bcas dang*// srid lus lhag chags zang zing bcas// 'dod yon lngar chags zhen pa brten// 'byung yul nyon mongs yang de rnams// sgo drug gis bcag chos gang la// skye 'jig gnas 'gyur snang 'dus byas// khams gsum 'das rjes la der snang*// spros pa'i gnas don 'jig rten pa// de ltar dgu mi zlog don rim// gzugs can min dang gtan med dang*// thogs med zag med 'thab med dang*// zang zing med dang mngon rten dang*// 'dus ma byas dang 'jig rten 'das// 'das dang da ltar nyer bzhi dgus// bsdus pa rgyu las byung phyir byung*// yod kyang ma byung mi rung bas// ma byung ba ste dbang lngas yul// sems dang sems byung chos dmigs 'dzin// mig rna yid gsum ma phrad par// sna lce lus phrad de gsum mnyam// mig rnas chung mnyam cha gsum dang*| /dbang shes da lta rang mtshan nyid// yid shes dus gsum gnyis ka 'dzin// shes gang yul gyi rnam skyes la// yul 'dzin zhes btags yid shes kyi// gzung bya mig sogs sems byung gsal// yul rnams yang ngo bstan las phyir// phyogs rnams 'dod srid 'brel 'byung bas// phyir ltas mnyam bzhag sa nang ltas| /ngo bo mtshungs ldan kun bslang bas// nyon mongs can gzhan nyon mongs min// byung la 'gags 'das dgu yis kyang*// rgyu yod ma byung ma 'ongs pa// brgyad kyi byung la ma 'gags pa// da lta bdun gyis der bzhag go

/de gsum gtam gzhi gtam ni ngag /thun mong snang yul sgras brjod bya// tha snyad brgyad gnas de'i gzhi'o// skyon med gnas dang gnyen po dang*// yon tan rjes mthun don gyi dge /ngo bos phye lnga gzhan sgos brgyad// du ma bskyed dang nyes spyod ni// kun nas slong don mi dge ba// bcu gnyis 'bras mi 'byin gnyen min// kun slong mi byed gnyis su brda'// sprad du med pas lung ma bstan// bcu bzhi 'ching ba mtha' dag can// de'i gsum 'dod ldan 'dod pa'i bral// gzugs min dge dang lung ma bstan// gzugs ldan gzugs las chags bral zhing*// gzugs med kyis min de'i gnyis ni// gzugs med ldan yid chags bral lnga// bcu yang thar cha nas thar brtson| /dge ba thams cad slob pa'i chos// bslab gsum slob phyir slob pa gsum// bslab gsum mthar phyin pa'i dge ba// zag bcas zag med mi slob chos// bslab bya med pas mi slob gsum// bsod nams cha mthun mi dge dang*// ma bstan 'dus ma byas gnyis min// mthong lam spang byar bstan mthong spangs// mthong spangs ma rtogs zag bcas rnams| /sgom spangs zag med gnyis su min// rten 'brel mtshan nyid yan lag dbye// mdor bsdus rkyen dang las rnam gzhag /nyon mongs bsdu dang don zab dbye// lugs mthun mi mthun rim pa bzhin// g.yo med mi rtag nus pa'i rkyen// yan lag bcu gnyis gsum 'phen pa// bzhi ni 'phangs pa gsum 'grub byed// gnyis grub bag chags shugs yid byed| /lhan cig 'byung ba bya ba rkyen// sred len nyon mongs 'du byed dang*// rnam shes srid las lhag rnams tshe'i// bcu gcig lngas brgyad kun byang gi'o// 'di rten 'brel 'byung phyir rkyen te// rgyu dang de ma thag dmigs pa// bdag po 'bras bu skyed byed rgyu// kun gzhi'i rnam smin 'du byed byung*// thar chas bsdus pa'i dge'i bag chags// ngo bo nyid khyad ma phye bar// rab dbye bcu dgu grogs la sogs// lhan cig mtshungs ldan skal mnyam dang*// kun 'gro rnam smin rim pas yin// mtshungs ldan rang 'gags par med par// gzhan skyed de ma thag pa'i rkyen// shes pa'i dmigs byar gyur dmigs rkyen// yul yongs chad sogs bcu gnyis dang*// med pa'i dmigs sogs nyi shu dgu// 'bras la dbang byed bdag rkyen dgu

/rnam shes ma bral de 'dra'i dbang*// yul la rgyun 'byung rten pa mtshungs// rnam shes bral dbang rang 'dra'i rgyun// 'byung ba rten bcas de mtshungs yin// 'dus shing dbang bsgyur zin pa dang*// lhag par dbang byed phyir dbang po// nyon mongs bcu bzhi rnam byang brgyad// dang po drug yul gnyis rig srog /ris mthun tshor ba'i lngas nyer spyod// dad sogs lngas ni 'jig rten gyi// sbyor nas mthong lam bco lnga'i bar// kun shes byed dang bcu drug brten// slob lam kun la kun shes dang*// mi slob lam la kun shes ldan// de gsum 'dir bstan 'das sa la'o// sems rten bye brag 'byed gnas dang*// kun nyon tshogs dang rnam byang byed// yang na 'jug rten skye gnas dang*| /nyer spyod ldog pa'ang rnam pa'i dbye// gtong thob ldan tshul gyis shes bya// rang gi mtshan nyid kho nas sdug /'gyur ba'i dbang byung yid mi bde// nyer len ldan pa 'du byed do| /rgyu 'bras ma bstan mi 'drar smin// rnam smin dngos btags gsum yang ste// 'ju bas kham zas 'dod na de// skye mched gsum gyi bdag nyid yin// gnyis phra gzhan rags yul re len// reg pa sems pa rnam shes zas// 'dod pa'i rags dang khams gong phra// byed bzhi myang 'das ma gtogs chos// gong bcas myang 'das gong na med// bsdus dbye gsum bzhi drug gis te// kun brtags rnam par brtags pa dang*// chos nyid kyis gang mtshan nyid gsum// mtshan nyid rnam pa lus rgyun bzhi// yongs shes gcig dang spangs pa'i dgu// phyi nang ltas ring yongs chad dang*// de dus kun tu ston pa drug /bsdus pa bcu gcig mtshan nyid khams// rigs skabs grogs phyogs dus phyogs gcig /mtha' dag gcig gis don dam gyi'o// dmigs pa mngon sdud phan yon yin// mtshungs ldan drug ste tha dad med// 'dres gyur phrad dang lhan cig 'byung*// bya ba bsgrub dang mthun par rtogs// mthun rtogs ngo bo khyad chos dbye// ldan pa 'phel 'grib la btags gang*// sa bon dbang dang kun 'byung ldan// nyon mongs lung ma bstan byung dge

/ma btsal kun 'byung de dag gi /sa bon nyams min ma bcom pa// de mngon gyur dang ma gyur ldan// sbyor byung dge lung ma bstan pa// 'byung ba'i rkyen gyis rgyu'i sa bon// yongs su brtas zin dbang dang ldan// da lta'i chos rnams rang mtshan du// mngon du gyur pa kun 'byung ldan// gang zag chos thob ldan tshul lo// chos mngon pa rnam par 'byed pa tshig le'ur byas pa las/ chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa dang po'o// // bden pa rnam des sdug kun dang*// 'gog lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'o// gang 'di gang du gang gis ni// ji ltar sdug bsngal las sdug bden// gang 'di sems can skye ba ste// srid pa lnga bcu rtsa brgyad po// 'gro bas lnga dang khams kyis gsum// rnam shes kyis gnas bdun nam dgu// lus tshe longs spyod skye thob pa// gang du skye ba'i gnas kyi ste// snod kyi 'jig rten rlung la chu// de la sa brten ri rab dang*// ri bdun bcu gnyis gling nang phyi'i// rgya mtsho khor yug ri bos skor// gangs can 'og nas sum khri dang*// nyis stong yang sos 'og nas 'og /bzhi stong bzhi stong dpyad gzhan bdun// de dag thad kha'i bar grang dmyal// 'di 'og lnga brgyar yi dwags khab// dud 'gro'i rtsa gnas rgya mtsho yin// chur nub lhun po'i seng lha min// bcu gcig gling mi gcig srin po// gnya' shing 'dzin rtser rgyal chen bzhi// sum cu rtsa gsum ri dbang spor// 'thab bral nas ni 'og min bar// nam mkhar gzugs med gnas med do// gnas gzhan lnga bcu rtsa bzhi las// sum cu rtsa drug 'dod pa'i khams// tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bcas pa gcig /gling bzhi de stong stong spyi phud// de stong stong bar de stong ni// stong gsum chen po khor yug gcig /'jig chags mnyam mo char rgyun dpes// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten tshad med bstan// smon dges bskyed pa dag pa'i zhing*// bsam mi khyab pa 'dis ma bsdus// gang gi sdug bsngal brgyad drug gsum// gnyis kyi ji ltar de bden mtshan// mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med// med dang rnam 'jig 'gyur ba 'bral// nye ba chos nyid gcig skad cig

/rgyun dang nad sogs sems sna tshogs// rgud dang snod 'jig chags mtshan nyid// mes bdun chus gcig tshar bdun mthar// me bdun de nas rlung gis so// bsam gtan gsum rim me che rlung*// bzhi pa lhan cig 'byung 'gag pas// dmyal zad snod med par 'jig stong*// dang po'i rlung nas mnar med pa'i// srid pa byung bar chags pa ste// 'bri dang 'phel 'grib bco brgyad 'phel// brgyad khri yan la 'khor los bsgyur// man nas brgya bar sangs rgyas so// bar ma gsum gyi bar bskal tshar// 'jig stong chags gnas rer nyi shu// brgyad cus bskal chen khams gong tshad// des mjal tshe bsod las zad 'chi// skye 'jig gnyis char gtogs pas gang*// mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal gsungs// de chos nyid 'brel 'du byed la'ang*// phung khams skye la rtag brtan dang*// ther zur rtag pa'i bdag bdag gi /med phyir de dag nges stong pa// rjes mthong lhag ma'i bdag med mthong*| /rnam rtog gang gi gang btags dngos// kun btags ngo bo nyid kyis stong*// snang ba de bzhin yod min pas// gzhan dbang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi// gzod nas gzung bar 'dzin gnyis kyi// stong pas yongs grub rang bzhin gyis// gsum la bdag smras btags mtshan nyid// ma rnyed pas na bdag med do// sems zin grub bde gcig dang 'gyur// gnas dang dbang gis 'byung dbang bsgyur// thar 'gyur ltos med 'jig pa'i phyir// gzugs ni skad cig nyid du grub// 'byung rdul phra rab phyogs der ni// 'byung gyur rdul yod yul gcig pas// 'byung ba las logs 'byung mthu med// rdul phran lus med blos dpyad tsam// shin rgyas srab sogs brgyad rab dbye// 'chi gsum gnyis kyi drod sdud bzhin// bar do gnag dkar mun snang yang*// 'dod gzugs skye tshe gzugs med 'pho// de ni yid byung dri za'o// re ltar thogs na zhag bdun pa// 'chi 'pho ci ste na bzlog ste// der las gsog phyir skal mnyam mthong*// skye 'gyur gzugs dang las shugs 'phrul// rdzu 'phrul can mtshungs skye gnas thogs// chags skyes de 'gag nying mtshams sbyor// mnyam pa srang mda'i mtho dma' bzhin// skyes nas srid pa'i mtsho 'dir 'khyam// kun 'byung nyon mongs de'i dbang gis// byung ba'i las gnyis 'byung nang dga'// de der mngon dgas sred gtso bo// dngos po gnas skabs dus khams 'tshol// rnam pa thams cad du 'gro bas// grangs mtshan 'byung dmigs mtshungs ldan dang*// rnam grangs log zhugs khams ris spongs// srid rtsa drug dang lta bas bcu// ngo bo nyid kyi ma zhir 'byung*// bag nyal ma spang yul snang dang*// tshul min yid la byed las 'byung*// nyon mongs rnams yin gzhi ma rtogs// gzhi med gzhi dang bcas par dmigs// rtsa nyon 'ga' zhig phan tshun mtshungs// nye nyon ma yin mi dge 'ga'// phal cher nyon mongs can mtshungs ldan| /rnam grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga ste// bsgrib bya'i dbang gis kun sbyor dgu

/sbyor byed tshul cis gang la sbyor// 'ching ba gsum gang gang la 'ching*// bag la nyal bdun ris 'dra ba| /phyi mar phan 'dogs gnas ngan len// 'dod sred log pas tshangs spyod 'tshol// ma spangs de dag rgyas par 'gyur// rtsa nyon gang yin dug gsum yang*// nyi shu ma yin nyon mongs byed// brgyad bzhir sems la 'khris kun dkris// rgyun phyogs khyer bas chu bo dang*// log sgrub thabs sbyor rtsod rtsas srid// len pas nyer len dgrol dka' mdud// bar du gcod pas rnam g.yeng ngo*// lnga ni bzhi tshan bdun gyi lnga// 'gebs phyir sgrib lnga las mi rung*// 'dral dkas tha ba 'chal tshul spyod// dri ma gnod par byed pa sdig /shin tu 'dod skyes zug rngu dang*// nyes dmigs mang ba ci yang dang*// log sgrub nyid ni nyer spyod dang*// sems 'phro zag dang dbul bas gnod// phongs pa lus sems mnar gdung ba// chags pa gzhan gyur 'khrug pa dang*// phan tshun gnod byed 'thab pa dang*// yongs su gdung ba che rims nad// lus ni sna tshogs sgrub byed nags// dge la mi sbyor gegs rnam gsum| /nyon mongs bcu ni sdug kun la// rgyu dang gzhi yis 'gog lam la// skrag pa skyed pas log par zhugs// khong khro 'dod khams gzhan kun na// tshor ba dag dang mtshungs par ldan// bden bzhi so sor 'dod na bcu// khams gong gnyis na dgu dgu ste// brgya rtsa bcu gnyis mthong spangs ris// 'dod par drug dang gnyis lnga lnga// bcu drug sgom spangs khong khror dgu /gzhan lngar gya gcig gya gcig gis// brgya dang bcu bzhi ji ltar spong*// yid byed ji 'dra gang zhig las// gzhi ngo nyes dmigs yongs shes nas// byung ba dang mi len yongs spangs// ma skyes spang ba'i lam rnyed pas// 'dres la dmigs pas spong ci'i phyir// mi rtag sogs brtan mi rtag la// brten nas duḥkha de shes nas// bdag med rnam thob yongs sbyongs don// shes lam rnam grol bla na med// 'das 'gags ma yongs ma byung dang*// da lta byung lam snyam mi 'jug

/de phyir mngon gyur la min pas// sa bon las 'dod de rnams rgyu// nyer brgyad gang gi dngos gnyen gyi// rnam pa de byung de 'gag pa// snyam pa snang dang mun pa bzhin// sa bon drungs phyungs mi skye'i chos// rnam grol 'dus ma byas gsum yin// nyon mongs byung las sems pa dang*// bsam pa'i gnyis dang rnam pa lnga// 'gro dang nges sems kyis sems pa// yid las bsod nams bsod nams min// mi g.yo gnyis sam g.yo byed kyi// 'jug byed bsam pa lus ngag dang*// yid las dge dang mi dge gnyis// srog gcod ma byin len log g.yem| /rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub 'khyal// brnab sems gnod sems log lta bcu// gzhi bsam sbyor nyon zin las lam// bzlog pa dge bcu lnga sems pa// de las gnyis ni byas bsags myong*// myong bar nges las gsum ste rer// 'bras gsum 'phen dang rdzogs pas byed// ches lci'i cha dus sngon goms sngar// byas pa las mang rim myong tshul// 'dod dge bsod nams mi dge ba// bsod nams ma yin khams gong dge /mi g.yo ma rig rkyen las byung*// thun mong thun mong min stobs dang*// stobs dang mi ldan gnang bkag dang*| /rab dbye sdom dang sdom min dang*// de gnyis min gsum sdom pa ni// so thar bsam gtan zag med do// ris brgyad sna gcig spyod lta bu// ldan dang 'chal pa nyid du'ang brjod| /bde sdug btang snyoms myong 'gyur dang*// mthong skye lan grangs gzhan myong dang*// gnag dkar 'dres ma las zad dang*// sbyin dang tshul khrims las rnams so// bdag gir bya dang bgo skal spyod// skye brtan mtho dma' ngan gya nom// sems can las dang rnal 'byor mthu// byang sems dbang dang sangs rgyas kyi// mdzad pa bsgrub pa'i phrin las rnams| /bsam gyis mi khyab nyid du brjod// rgyu dang kun 'byung rab skye dang*// rkyen gyi mtshan nyid kyis de dag

/'khor ba'i rgyur ni bzhag pa yin// 'gog bden mtshan nyid zab dang brda// don dam ma rdzogs rdzogs rgyan med// rgyan bcas lhag bcas lhag med dang*// khyad 'phags rnam grangs dag gis so// gang du 'gog pa de bzhin nyid| /gang gis 'gog pa zag med lam// gang 'gog nyon mongs mi 'byung bar// dang po'i lung don phyi ma'i ni// de bzhin nyid la dmigs gang du// zag bcas dngos po rnam 'gags pa// de ni lhag med 'gog mtshan nyid// 'du byed zhi tsam yin phyir 'gog /de dag gis 'jig las gzhan min// mtshan nyid mi 'dras gzhan min min// de phyir gnyis min rang rig pas// gnyis ka min pa min pas na// spros med mya ngan 'das gsungs zab// zag bcas lam gyi nyon mongs pa'i// sa bon nyams smad 'gog gang yin// rnam grangs yan lag myang 'das brda// 'phags shes kun tu bcom don dam// bslab pa gsum gyi spangs ma rdzogs// mi slob pa'i rdzogs shes rab kyi// rnam grol gnyis cha las grol ba| /mngon par shes rkyen med yod kyi// phung po'i lhag bcas ma bcas de'i// mi gnas myang 'das khyad du 'phags// ma lus spangs dang nges par spangs// byang gyur zad pa 'dod chags bral// 'gog rnam zhi nub 'dus ma byas// lta dka' g.yo med mi 'dud pa// 'chi med zag med gnas gling skyob// mgon dpung 'chi 'pho med rims med// gdung med bde zhi bde ba'i gzhi// bde bar 'gyur dang nad med dang*// mi g.yo myang 'das ma skyes dang*// ma byung ma byas las nyon gyi// 'dus ma byas skye med rnam grangs// 'gog zhi gya nom nges par 'byung*// lam bden bden bzhi'i mngon rtogs rim// tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mthar phyin lam// tshul khrims dbang po bsdams zad shes// mi nyal shes bzhin dge gzhan dang*// shes rab gsum bsgom snang nyid 'gyur// de'i gang drod rtse bzod chos mchog /so so rang gi bden rnams la// snang ba thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin// shes rab mtshungs ldan bcas pa drod// de ltar snang ba mched pa dang*// phyogs gcig la zhugs rjes su song*// de ma thag sems de'i mjug tu// mi dmigs ting 'dzin de nyid shes// mtshungs ldan gcig gis dmigs bya dang*// dmigs byed mnyam pas mnyam shes dang*// so so rang la sems can chos// thams cad du gnyis brda bsal la// dmigs pa'i chos shes pa'ang de// de ni spros med spros bcas na// bden dang bden la bzod shes dang*// rjes su bzod shes skad cig ma// bcu drug ma mthong mthong ba'i lam// sdug bsngal bden dbang byas pa'i chos// sbyor ba de la rnam dpyad shes// bar chad med pa'i lam gang gis// sdug bsngal mthong spangs spong de bzod// de yi mjug thogs rnam grol shes| /'di gnyis 'phags chos rgyur gtogs pa'i// zag med shes rab rjes bzod dang*// bzod de nges 'dzin rjes shes so// bden pa lhag mar de bzhin sbyar// gzung rtogs 'dzin rtogs mtshan med gnas// skad cig bya ba rdzogs pa'i 'o// chos mig rdul med dri bral te// chos mthong thob dang rig rtogs dang*// brgal gnyis dring la mi 'jog dang*// gzhan gyi mi bkri mi 'jigs thob// gong gyur 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das// chung 'bring che dang sbyor ba dang*// bar chad med dang rnam grol dang*// khyad par lam mo bsam gzugs brgyad| /kun byang rnam gzhag rnam dag sgros// lung ma bstan rtsa bzhis nyon mongs// rang nyon kun dkris bral rnam byang*// de yang nyams gnas khyad cha mthun// bar med thod rgal ci dgar 'jug

/yan lag snyoms 'jug tshad ming gdags// lnga bzhi lnga bzhi bsam gtan bzhir// gzugs med ro gcig yan lag med// mtshan nyid rab tu yid byed dang*// mos byung rab dben dga' sdud dpyod// sbyor mtha' sbyor mtha'i 'bras yid byed// 'dis ni ngang nas tha ma'i bar// snyoms 'jug drug ni nyer bsdogs dang*// mi lcogs med mtha' dngos gzhi yin// rgyu tshad chung 'bring cher bsgoms pas// 'bras tshad bsam gtan skyes gsum gsum// khyad par can bsgoms tshangs chen no// gzugs med mtho dma' ngan dang bzang*| /ming du btags pa bsam mi khyab// kun gyi sa mthun 'phel mthar phyin// bden bzhi mthong bas rtog thun dmigs// dang po'i nyer bsdogs nas bzung nas// ci yang med par de dag nyid// zag med shes rab mtshungs ldan du// skyes pas der 'gyur srid rtse ni// 'du shes rgyu ba mi gsal bas// rten du mi rung bas 'jig rten// 'du shes gsal bas snyoms 'jug pa// de tsam kun shes 'das lam gtogs// dgu pa 'gog snyoms 'das pa yin// mi rten la skyed tshe der ram// shi na gzugs su mngon du byed// 'bad rtsom med phyir gzugs med min// lam ni chung ngu'i chung sogs kyi// sa dgu dag tu khams gsum na// spyod pa'i nyon mongs rnam pa ni// chen po'i chen po la sogs spong*// de yi sbyor lam ngos skal gyi// sa bon cha re tsam spong ba// dngos gnyen de yis de spong la// bar chad med pa gang spangs de'i// rnam grol mngon du byed pa'o// 'bring spong sbyor sogs gsum lta bu// snga ma la ltos khyad par lam// gsum dang gnyis yang lam bsgom pa// thob par bya dang brten pa dang*// bsal phyir gnyen po bsgom pa'o// sun 'byin spong ba rten thag ring*// dngos la yongs rtog rtsol bas byung*// spyod byed sbyor dang 'dres mngon rtogs// nges 'byin tha dad bslab gsum spyod// sgrub par byed dang sdud pa'i lam// de dag dran pa nyer bzhag dang*// yang dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang*// dbang stobs byang chub yan lag dang*// 'phags lam dmigs pa ngo bo dang*// sgom dang 'bras bu zhib bshad do// lam bzhi chos kyi gnas bzhi dang*// zhi lhag dbang po gsum rim bzhin// gong ma'i lam mo des 'og ma'i// dge yang rgyas te dbang 'byor phyir// gnas ngan len pa nyi shu bzhi// de bsags phrad thob rgyun gcod dang*// de zad bral ba'i thob thob phyir// sbyor bcas bar chad med pa'i lam// sgrib pa kun gyis mi khyab cing*// mi shigs brtan sra khyab pas gang*// rdo rje lta bu de'i 'og tu// gnas gyur zad shes mi skye shes// mi slob pa yi chos bcu'o// lam dang rigs pa sgrub pa dang*// nges par 'byin mtshon don bsdu yin| /chos mngon pa rnam par 'byed pa tshig le'ur byas pa las/

bden pa rnam par nges pa bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// // chos rnam nges pa chos spyod yul// dmigs dang rigs pa kun 'tshol shes// rnal 'byor sa mkhas gnas dang rgyas// mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan dang*// tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang*// rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang*// skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang*// rmad byung gtan la phab pa'i sde'i// lnga ni nyan thos mdo sde bzhi// 'dul dang gnyis ni byang sems mdo// gnyis ka'i mngon pa gcig rim bzhin// gnyen po bslab gsum chos don dang*// 'bel ba'i gtam gyis sde snod gsum// dmigs rnam gnas mtshungs ldan pa yis// thos bsam bsgom las byung ba'i sems// sems byung rnams kyi spyod yul yin// khyab dang spyod pa rnam spyod dang*// mkhas dang nyon mongs rnam sbyong dmigs// bstod dang bya byed gtan tshigs bsgrub// chos nyid rigs pas dpyod de la// ming dngos ngo bo nyid khyad du// 'dogs pa kun 'tshol de'i yongs shes// gzhi skye me long lhar snang gnas// tshig don yi ge nges pa'i tshig /dgongs mkhas thos bsam sgom la sbyor// shin tu rgyas gang phar phyin gyi// sde snod 'jog rgyu zab rgyas rgyu// mi mos skrag rgyu mi 'byung rgyu// ngo bo nyid med skye med sogs// dgongs dang ldem por dgongs pa dang*// ting 'dzin mkhas dang mchod 'os bstan// chos mngon pa rnam par 'byed pa tshig le'ur byas pa las/ chos rnam par nges pa bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// // thob pa rnam par nges pa gang*// gang zag mngon rtogs 'bras so bdun// spyod pas phye gsum nges 'byung gsum// nyer bstan pas gsum sbyor bas gnyis// 'bras bu nyer bdun khams bcu gsum// spyod pas phye ba rnam lnga'o// 'dod sdang gti mug nga rgyal ba// cha mnyam chung spyod 'dun nyon mongs// shes che mnyam chung sgo nas bzhag

/nyan rang theg pa chen po la// rigs dang rang bzhin sems bskyed bsam// dmigs bsgrub 'bras bu'i khyad kyis 'byed// tshogs ma bsags dang gnyis min bsags// tshogs dang sbyor la nyams pa zhar// dad dang chos kyi rjes 'brang ba// dbang rtul gzhan dring 'jog pa dang*// dbang rnon shes rab rjes 'brangs nas// bden pa mngon rtogs la sbyor bas// de gnyis bsgom pa'i lam du ni// dad pas mos dang mthong bas thob// snyoms 'jug las ni lus mngon byang*// tshe yongs gyur dang de nyid dang*// gzhan ni shi nas gzugs khams du'o// shes rab stobs kyis nyon mongs grol// rnam par thar sgrib las min dang*// shes rab snyom 'jug gnyis ka yi// gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol lo// nges 'byed cha nas bco lnga'i bar// bsgom spang ma spangs 'jig lam du// rnam lnga'i bar bcom dang po'i zhugs// sngar brgyad spangs pa gnyis pa la// dgu ga'am ci yang med tshul bral// gsum pa gang la zhugs pa de'i// bcu drug pa la de 'bras bzhag /'bras bu khyad par bya phyir brtson// zhugs pa 'bras gnas lnga bcom pa// gnyis zhugs drug zad phyir mi 'ong*// bdun dang brgyad spangs gsum zhugs pa// rnam dgu zad pa phyir mi 'ong*// srid rtse'i brgyad dang dgu'i spong lam// dgra bcom nyid zhugs de zad thob// zad pa shes pa dgra bcom pa// 'bras gnas bsgom spangs gcig tsam yang*// ma spangs re ltar thog na bdun// rnam gsum bzhi bcom rigs nas rigs| /bdun brgyad zad tshe bar chad gcig /kun sbyor gcig spangs bar srid 'da'// gnyis ka ma spangs gzugs 'ongs pa// skyes ma thag dang 'du shes med// 'du byed bcas bzhi gzugs med la// bar srid ma gtogs gzhan mtshungs so// gong 'og gnyis te bzhi pa la// chung 'bring che dang ches cher dang*// shin tu spel bsgoms 'og min 'gro| /nyams 'phar phyed 'phar thams cad du// 'chi 'pho ma spel bsgom srid rtse// dgra bcom drug 'dod de dag las// lnga ni dad dang mos las byung*// bde bar gnas las nyams 'gyur srid// gcig ni mthong bas thob pa las// mthong chos bder gnas dus dang sbyor// kun gyi rnam grol mi g.yo ba// khams gsum spyod pa so skye dang*// kun sbyor lhag ma yod med pa'i// 'phags chos thob gnyis 'dod gzugs ni// dbang thob byang sems 'dod rang rgyal// mchog gi sprul pa'i sku yang yin// chos spyod tshogs sbyor lhag bsam spyod| /nyon mongs can min sgrib pa bcu// mi mthun phyogs gnyen sa bcur gnas// de las drug ni mtshan mar spyod// gcig ni mtshan med dag pa'i gsum// 'du byed med par spyod pa yin// mthong gtogs mi lcogs med brten nas// 'das pa'i lam gyi khams gsum pa'i// nyon mongs thams cad cig car spong*// 'bras gnyis la btags mthong chos sam| /'chi tshe dgra bcom ma byas de// smon lam stobs kyis rang rgyal 'phen// mngon par rtogs pa bcur bshad pa// chos don kho na rjes mngon rtogs// tshogs sbyor mthong dang sgom pa'i lam// dkon mchog kun tu mi 'byung dang*// mthar thug nyan rang byang mngon rtogs// dad dang mi bya'i sdom thob dang*// mthar phyin lam gyi gsum bzhag la// de ltar bdun gyi tha ma gsum// nyan thos sems dpa'i khyad nyer gcig

/tshad med rnam thar zil gnon dang*// zad par nyon mongs med bsams shes// so so yang dag rig mngon shes// mtshan dpe yongs dag stobs mi 'jigs// dran pa nyer bzhag bsrung ba med// bsnyel ba mi mnga' bag chags bcom// thugs rje che dang ma 'dres chos| /rnam mkhyen de dag phyed las bcas// khyad 'phags lam thob sngar dman 'dor// lhag med dbyings su nyan thos lam// rgyun gcod de ltar byang sems min// de phyir rgyu 'bras mi zad bstan// tshul min dri phyir lung mi ston// rgyun ma grub srid tshad med skye// de phyir 'bras bu gsum 'gyur min// bden rtogs bsgom la shes sgrib kyi// gnyen po brten gyi nyon sgrib min// byang chub thob tshe cig car spang*// cig car dgra bcom bde gshegs 'gyur// sngags kyis bsad pa'i dug bzhin du// mi rtog ye shes kyis zin pas// nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur// de phyir byang sems shes bya dang*// rnam rtog rnam mi rtog la mkhas// gnyis kyi dbang po sbyor ba'ang byed// chos mngon pa rnam par 'byed pa tshig le'ur byas pa las/ thob pa rnam par nges pa bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa bzhi pa'o// // 'bel gtam rnam nges don dang ni// rnam shes phye nas kun tu bstan// yang dag dri dang bsdu ba dang*// smra dang ldem dgongs rnam nges so// ngo bo nyid dang rgyu 'bras dang*// las ldan 'jug pa gsum dang gsum// lnga tshan bzhis bstan bshad bya'o// sgo drug gi dang bcu bzhi ni// de gsal byed pa'i rnam bshad yin// chos gang chos gzhan dang sbyar nas// mu bzhi de bzhin no zhes ston// de 'dra med ces spong ba ni// rab phye kun tu ston pa yin| /rnam dbye bdun ni dbye ba dang*// bcas pa sbyar brgyad yang dag gi /rnam par nges pa'i lam bzhis so// gnas bcu yi ni dgos pa bsdu// smra ba smra ba'i zhal lce dang*// smra ba'i gzhi dang smra ba'i rgyan// smra ba chad pas bcad pa dang*// smra las 'byung smrar gces spras so// dang po gnyis ni drug drug gi

/smra ba'i gzhi 'dir bsgrub bya gnyis// sgrub byed brgyad dang lhag rim bzhi// lnga gsum drug dang gnyis kyis bshad// mi rtsod dmigs bsal gnas bcu gnyis// gzhan brjod don gzhan bsgyur ldem dgongs// sdig to dge ba ngan pa mchog /'khor ba'i rgyu ni byang chub rgyur// spang bya gnyen por bsgyur ba bzhi// de ltar 'phags pa thogs med gzhung lugs mtsho// shin tu rgya che'i kha dog gis skrag nas// 'jug ngogs dor la tshig lo'i chu klung gi /re skong klu dbang pad dkar 'dzin 'di'o// chos mngon pa rnam par 'byed pa tshig le'ur byas pa las/ 'bel ba'i gtam rnam par nges pa bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa lnga pa'o/ /chos mngon pa rnam par 'byed pa gangs kyi ri'i paṇḍi ta padma dkar pos sbyar ba rdzogs so// mtshams sbyar legs la brgal lan ran par bstan// dgos pa rgya che bsdus pa 'gag 'dril la// tshig don legs par phyin 'dis kun las btus// nyin byed 'dab brgya phrad bzhin rgyas gyur cig/ //
